messages:
release-ops: Heads-up: were initiating an emergency release freeze for a CUDA driver hotpatch in us-west-2. Start: 22:00 UTC tonight. Expected window ~3 hours. A subset of Dedicated GPU pools + canaries affected. Follow the condensed playbook below.

release-ops: Summary: pause new canaries, suspend scheduled rollouts touching affected pools, apply hotpatch to infra nodes, validate runtime & KV cache, then resume with a fast-rollout.

release-ops: Condensed playbook:
```
1) pause canary lane: curl -X POST $RELEASE_API/planes/canary/pause
2) cordon nodes: kubectl cordon gpu-usw2-pool-*
3) run driver install: ansible -i inventories/usw2 -m shell -a 'install_cuda_470_patch.sh'
4) rolling restart runtime pods (graceful): kubectl rollout restart ds/inference-runtime
5) run smoke: ./infra/ops/smoke_canary_check.sh --duration 10m
6) if smoke fails -> /rollout cancel --reason "cuda-hotpatch-regression"
```

deploy-bot: @release-ops Ive applied "canary:paused" tag to active trains for tonight. Will emit incremental updates. :gear:

oncall-eric: Ill start pre-patch health checks at 21:45 UTC and stand by on pager.

maya: Quick Q: should account teams warn customers on Dedicated?

karen: Minimal exposure expected. Were patching a small subset; traffic fallback to other regions possible if needed. Recommend a small CS advisory if maintenance overlaps reserved windows.

sahil: Ill draft a CS note and post to #support in ~10m.

release-ops: Action items:
- @sahil: CS advisory (10m)
- @oncall-eric: pre-patch baseline checks at 21:50 UTC
- @k8s-bot: annotate nodes with patch-id=usw2-cuda-470p1

k8s-bot: Annotation CR created: patch-usw2-cuda-470p1 attached to 5 nodes.

deploy-bot: Rolling hotpatch to annotated nodes starting 22:05 UTC. Updates every 15m or sooner on errors.

oncall-eric: Pre-patch baseline green: p50/p95 latency within normal; KV cache hit-rate steady.

release-ops: Rollback thresholds: sustained error-rate >3% for 5m OR p95 latency regression >150ms for 5m -> execute rollback and escalate.

maya: Ive flagged tonights trains as frozen on the release calendar.

karen: Adding an entry to next weekly digest under incident notes so this appears in the changelog.

sahil: CS advisory posted: "Planned infrastructure patch in us-west-2 tonight; brief canary/reserved GPU impact possible. No action needed unless you see service disruption." https://intranet.ops/patches/usw2-cuda-470p1

deploy-bot: Patch applied to 5/5 nodes. Initiating rolling runtime restarts.

k8s-bot: Runtime pods restarted; readiness probes passing across patched nodes.

release-ops: Running 10m post-patch smoke. If green, lift freeze and resume canaries at ~01:10 UTC with fast-rollout.

oncall-eric: Post-patch smoke 12m complete, no regressions detected. Metrics stable.

release-ops: Freeze lifted. Resuming canaries with fast-rollout policy. Monitoring closely. :rocket:

maya: Thanks all. Ill add a short note to the weekly release train: "Emergency CUDA driver hotpatch in us-west-2; ~3h freeze, no customer-facing impact."

karen: Changelog updated. Closing once deploy-bot confirms stable metrics for 1h.

deploy-bot: Metrics stable for 25m. Will report at +60m.

oncall-eric: Oncall standing down but will continue to monitor for 1h.

release-ops: Great teamwork, thanks. If anything pops up, re-open this thread and tag @release-ops. :bow:
